title: AI selloff casts shadow over DeepSeek and Moonshot listing plans
summary: A global AI stock selloff that followed Anthropic&\#x27;s record $119.5 billion IPO is clouding planned or considered share sales by Chinese AI developers DeepSeek, Moonshot and StepFun, Bloomberg reported. Chinese tech stocks have lost a combined $1.7 trillion in market value since late June, while Zhipu has fallen more than 85% from its June peak and MiniMax dropped below its issue price this month, according to the report.
